metadata.description: One-stop media ingestion for AI agents. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes (captions / Whisper / multimodal), and hands it all to the agent.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video or audio file (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions, Whisper, or multimodal AI — and hands frames + transcript to the agent.
